name: Further Education
source:
A Savant detective for some, Criminal-In-Making for others, A reserved maverick who'll do whatever it takes to solve the case.

Flynn Casey is a lot of things, but in a place where his expertise isn't needed, he's forced to confront his shortcomings until he finally finds his calling- In USA.

Further Education is a Slice-of-life set in a alternate history full of political and geopolitical tension, friendship, brutal reality and love that spans the globe.

[From [url=https://kvitravntales.itch.io/further-education]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
对于某些人来说，他是一名天才侦探；对于另一些人来说，他是一名正在犯罪的人；对于另一些人来说，他是一名内向的特立独行者，会不惜一切代价破案。

弗林·凯西 (Flynn Casey) 有很多事情，但在一个不需要他的专业知识的地方，他被迫面对自己的缺点，直到他最终找到自己的使命——在美国。

继续教育是一段生活的片段，背景设定在另一个历史中，充满了政治和地缘政治的紧张局势、友谊、残酷的现实和遍布全球的爱。

[来自[url=https://kvitravntales.itch.io/further-education]Itch.io[/url]]
